title: "prac3_exercises"

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}

for (i in 1:20) {
  print(i^3)
}
```

```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
all_courses = tibble()

for (i in 1:10) {
  next_course = tibble(
    Food = sample(breakfast, size=1),
    Amount = sample(5, size=1)
  )
  all_courses <- bind_rows(all_courses, next_course)
}

gt(all_courses)
```
